# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/firebase
# args: 
Usage: firebase functions [options] [command]

manage Cloud Functions

Options:
  -h, --help                               display help for command

Commands:
  functions:delete [options] [filters...]  delete one or more Cloud Functions by name, group name, or codebase.
  functions:log [options]                  read logs from deployed functions
  functions:shell [options]                launch full Node shell with emulated functions
  functions:list                           list all deployed functions in your Firebase project
  functions:config                         manage functions:config resources
  functions:lifecycle                      manage functions:lifecycle resources
  functions:secrets                        manage functions:secrets resources
  functions:artifacts                      manage functions:artifacts resources

To see more about a specific command, run:
  firebase functions:<command> --help
